admission: governed-element rule: clearly related to StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#431 (organization-ledger onboarding), which designates the location this transition pins

trigger.org_side_emitter: StegVerse-org/.github .github/workflows/intr-path-transfer.yml (existing path transfer; no new workflow, no .github change)
trigger.carrier_shapes: llm_adapter/intr_transport_carrier.py (byte copy of #432/#433): source half retained at <namespace>/source-receipts/<hex>.json, destination half ORGANIZATION_INTR_DESTINATION_INGRESS on the namespace chain, body = the signal

receiver.entrypoint: scripts/llm_adapter_genesis_pin_ingress.py receive --signal <genesis-observed signal json> --carrier <{destination_receipt_sha256, org_ledger_head_receipt_sha256, org_ledger_head_attestation} json> --org-ledger <read-only copy of refs/stegverse/organization-ledger>
receiver.authenticates_by: the genesis-pin planner's own chain-to-sealed-genesis verification over the published refs/stegverse/organization-ledger read-back, plus the org-ledger head attestation over that genesis, head and namespace tree by a key published in .stegverse/node-ledger/org-ledger-head-signers.v1.json (ORG-LEDGER-HEAD-SIGNER-001, TV/TVC custody; llm_adapter/org_ledger_location.py byte copy of #432's), plus intr_transport_carrier.verify; never the pin (LC-KV-19)
receiver.after_pin: FAIL_CLOSED PRE_PIN_INGRESS_CLOSED; signals take the normal InTr gate (intr_transport_carrier.observe through org_ledger_location.designated_org_ledger, #433)
receiver.unattested_copy: FAIL_CLOSED MERGE_APPEND_PATH_NOT_ADMITTED while no head signer is published; ORG_LEDGER_HEAD_NOT_AUTHENTICATED for a missing, mismatched, unpublished or badly signed attestation (six fields)

trigger.wiring_note: Coordination ruling option (b), Lane B (#162): the trigger arrives as an InTr ingress signal from the existing org path transfer. The org emitter's message builder at StegVerse-org/.github@907f4305 (resident-runtime/intr_path_transfer.py message/path_evidence) fixes the body to {schema, path_id, transfer_commit} and does not carry destination_location or endpoint_kind; carrying this signal in the carrier shape is an org-side precondition outside this repository and is not changed here. Carrying it is StegVerse-org/.github#235 (INTR-PATH-TRANSFER-TYPED-BODY-001, ADMISSION_ORDER step 2a).

entrypoint: scripts/llm_adapter_repository_ledger_genesis_pin.py plan --org-ledger <read-only copy of refs/stegverse/organization-ledger> --genesis-receipt <sha256 named by the receipted genesis record> --head-attestation <stegverse.org-ledger-head-attestation/v1 json>
reads: the namespace chain from repository-ledger/StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter/HEAD.json back to its sealed REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION root

writes.value: the observed genesis receipt_sha256, read back; never computed in advance

consumes_receipt: a REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN repository receipt appended by .stegverse/transition-ledger/emit.py (unchanged) whose evidence.consumes_receipt_sha256 is the genesis receipt_sha256 and whose predecessor and successor state digests are the contract bytes before and after
idempotent: a contract already pinned to the observed genesis plans no write and no receipt
